reason: Mere customers ka udhaar ka hisaab ek AI ko dene ka mann nahi hai. Maine Khatabook aur OkCredit pehle bhi daala tha, kuch din baad update karna chhod diya; kaagaz ki diary hi chal rahi hai.
objection: I don't trust an app or AI with my customers' udhaar details, and I know I will stop using it when the counter gets busy, like I did with the ledger apps.
would_change_my_mind: If a person I know and trust in my area already uses it for their own shop and shows me that it works, and the khata stays only on my phone and nobody else can see it.
